column1: # NOT A DECLARED FAMILY AND NOT ONE FAMILY.
# 12-byte `lea rcx,[a static] ; jmp` bodies that register with the atexit wrapper
# 00808B90 by the TAIL-CALL spelling (add rsp,N ; jmp) and that no EC-7 family
# declares. They fall in several target clusters and are almost certainly several
# families - derive each form from its own members rather than from the shared
# spelling, which is a place to look and not provenance.
# 44 of them sit at a target NativeAdapter.StaticAddressTailCall already declares
# members at, and 0016D6A0 is also the sole target of the Control Flow Guard
# family - so ownership of that cluster is a boundary question between two
# accepted families, not a members-file refresh.
